title: Claim decision body
description: The Insurer's decision on a claim (bank-insurer.md 3 and 5, register row DK20; spec-delta S281). Signed by the Insurer. The log recomputes it from the settlement and the policy's terms: a covered event is not denied, a denial gives the reason the terms give, the amount is what the terms give or less only because the reserve is short (`reduced`), and the payment comes out of the reserve, never beyond it. Chain: none (prev is null).
